deploy-bot: Promoting to prod -> started 14:32:05 UTC. Traffic ramp 30% -> 100% over 10m. Monitors active.

Carla: Promotion completed 14:42 UTC. Post-check: all green. Merging release notes and closing RC. Thanks team :tada:
